content.title: Got a tattoo? Chipotle's BOGO deal lasts one hour on Friday the 13th
content.text: This Friday the 13th, showing off your tats can get you some free lunch.  Chipotle Mexican Grill announced its “tatted like a Chipotle bag” buy-one-get-one promotion, scheduled for a one-hour window on March 13 for customers who show up to restaurants with any tattoos. The promotion will run from 3 to 4 p.m. local time at participating locations in the U.S., Canada, the United Kingdom, France and Germany. Chipotle partnered with multi-platinum hip-hop artist Swae Lee, of Rae Sremmurd, to co-design an exclusive temporary tattoo flash sheet inspired by the artwork featured on Chipotle’s takeout bags. “'Tatted like a Chipotle bag' is really about self-expression,” Lee said. “It was cool to bring it into the real world and create designs that actually feel like me.” Here’s what to know about the promotion. Do you need a permanent tattoo to get the Chipotle deal?  It doesn’t matter what kind of ink you have, Chipotle reassures. Customers with any type of tattoo — whether it’s permanent, temporary or a drawn-on design — can get the BOGO offer during the one-hour window.  The promotion is inspired by the Friday the 13th “flash tattoo” tradition, in which tattoo shops offer sheets of small, pre-designed tattoos in celebration of the day. It’s also a nod to a viral social media trend in which users say they’re “tatted like a Chipotle bag,” which gained popularity in 2024. “What started as an internet meme became a real-world expression of fandom for our brand,” said Stephanie Perdue, Chipotle’s interim chief marketing officer. Chipotle said a similar tattoo-themed buy-one-get-one promotion in June 2025 drove the company’s highest mid-afternoon sales on record. The March 13 offer is valid for in-restaurant purchases only and requires customers to buy an entrée of equal or greater value to receive a free item. Additional restrictions may apply, according to the company.
